description: Land Acquisition - Supplements 66, 234, 84, 251, 83 and 250 in Topo PP 13 of Galgedawala, Laggala-Pallegama D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition for the Moragahakanda & Kaluganga Development Project. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters. The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
